editionLabel: English UK publisher rules, eight-page PDF
firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently had to wait for a train is the first active player.
officialTieBreak: If nobody has had to wait for a train, the group decides who starts.
clarifications: This selects the first active player in a cooperative game. The group can discuss actions, with the active player deciding when there is disagreement.
evidenceNotes: Used the publisher's UK file. The separate US download was not used as evidence because it exceeded the retrieval size limit.
